_comment: The pieces of the info bar under the predictions, replayed through _shared/lua/llm/request_plan/info_bar.lua by the macOS and Linux runners. Pieces come in the order model, backend, the prompt's short name, position i/n; a prompt label is cut at its first em dash on every OS (Linux used to keep a label that begins with the dash). Deliberate differences stay in the options: require_model is macOS (no model, no bar), position is Linux (it cycles candidates and shows i/n; macOS lists them all). The separator is the driver's: macOS joins with an em dash, Linux with a middle dot.

drivers.windows: Not ported yet: the AutoHotkey tooltip builds its own info line; it must use the same order (model, backend, short prompt name) and the em dash cut of the label, and replay every vector.

differences.separator: macOS joins with an em dash, Linux with a middle dot. Deliberate: each matches its tooltip's typography and existing screenshots; the pieces and their order are shared.
differences.position: Linux cycles candidates and shows i/n; macOS lists every candidate and shows none. Deliberate: the position only means something where one candidate is active.
differences.backend: Linux has no backend label (one local HTTP stack); macOS names Ollama or MLX. Deliberate: the caller passes none.
differences.require_model: macOS hides the whole bar without a model; Linux still names the prompt. Deliberate, kept to avoid changing what either shows.
differences.label_cut: Linux used to cut only the built-in prompts' translated labels and showed a user prompt's label whole, and kept a label that begins with the dash. Convergence to the macOS rule on both counts.

vectors.expect_error: position must be { index, count } numbers
